name: image-only-pricing
description: Clean site whose pricing page shows plans and prices only inside a PNG; no price text anywhere on the site.

expected.notes: image_only on /pricing (high; low confidence by default, medium if the filename and alt both signal pricing). key_fact_missing lists exactly pricing_or_trial (partial: the site only mentions a free trial). The image has alt text, so alt_text_missing must pass: alt presence is not the same as extractable price text. The pricing page keeps a price-free FAQ and the product JSON-LD keeps aggregateRating in place of offers, so faq_absent and required_props_missing stay green and the fixture isolates the image-only defect.
